name: Stasis Web
description: Projects a stasis field that slows the locked target by 45% while it runs. The cycle takes five seconds and draws 10 GJ each time. Bůral's electronic-warfare line leads with the web, and the convoy offices on the Charter lanes list it as the first fitting for a hauler.

name: Warp Scrambler
description: Disrupts the locked target's warp drive for ten seconds per cycle, drawing 10 GJ every five seconds. Bůral builds it beside the stasis web, and the district's fitters pair the two whenever a hull is meant to hold what it engages.

name: Target Painter
description: Adds 25% to the locked target's signature radius while the cycle runs, drawing 10 GJ every five seconds, so the hull locks faster and turret fire finds it more surely. Bůral's electronic-warfare line pairs it with the stasis web, and the house sells it to hulls that mean to hold what they engage.

name: Sensor Dampener
description: Cuts the locked target's scan resolution by 45% for the duration of each five second cycle, drawing 10 GJ. Bůral's electronic-warfare line fits it beside the painter, and the house says the dampener is what keeps a fast hull from fixing a lock at all.
